settings.title: Quick Drop
settings.text:
Use this if you want the same scan preferences applied to all film you’re dropping off
(including single-film orders).

settings.title: Custom Order
settings.text: Use this if you want different scan preferences for different film types in the same order

settings.title: Pick Your Film & Scan Size
settings.content: We process C41 (Colour Negative), B&W, and ECN-2 (Cine) film in 35mm and 120 formats.

settings.title: Choose Your Scanner & Preferences
settings.content:
Scanner
We scan on our beautiful Noritsu scanner by default. Prefer a different look? Choose another classic scanner: the FujiFilm Frontier (Socials, Classic, or Pro) or Kodak Pakon (Socials only).

Scan Preferences
For Classic and Pro scans, you can select your contrast preference —or leave it to our standard lab finishing. Either way, every roll is scanned consistently to our premium quality.

settings.title: Decide What Happens to Your Negatives
settings.content: By default, we cut negatives into strips of six and sleeve them for collection. Prefer uncut or mailed to you ? Just let us know. View our full negative-handling info Click Here.

settings.title: Select payment & Submit Order
settings.content: Either Pay when placing your order, or select ‘pay later’ and we’ll send a payment link once your rolls reach the lab and are checked against your order.

settings.title: Stay Updated
settings.content: We’ll keep you posted at every stage—when your order’s in-progress, when scans ready to download, and when your negatives are ready to pick up.
